theorems.name: Submission.constancy_mdc_weak_partials_vanish
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl n)) (u : (Eucl n → ℝ) → ℝ), (∀ a : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ U → ∀ j : Fin n, u (fun x => fderiv ℝ a x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) = 0) → ∀ (x₀ : Eucl n) (ρ ε : ℝ), closedBall x₀ (ρ + ε) ⊆ U → ∀ φ : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ closedBall 0 ε → ∀ θ : Eucl n → ℝ, (∀ f : Eucl n → ℝ, IntegrableOn f (ball x₀ ρ) volume → u (convolution φ ((ball x₀ ρ).indicator f) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) = ∫ x in ball x₀ ρ, f x * θ x ∂volume) → ∀ a : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ ball x₀ ρ → ∀ j : Fin n, ∫ x, θ x * fderiv ℝ a x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
